I have only 0.08 hectares here for maize, which I intercrop with groundnuts to make the most of the small land. I will apply some chemical fertilizer that I received through the subsidy program, about enough for this plot, and I will also add manure because it helps the soil. I am using improved seed this season since it grows better, but I will not buy pesticides or irrigate because those cost too much money. My family will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves, so we will not hire any workers.
